items.text: Master Liganor opened a pottery shop in Urithiru's market, with a workroom and showroom below and his rooms upstairs. Once he employed Gub and Alalan, he handed the glaze work to Gub. He kept the shop open during Raboniel's occupation; one day, sensing a fight brewing in the atrium, he looked to Alalan for approval to close, locked the door and went upstairs.

appearance.text: A nice older man, short, bald and somewhat tubby, with a short neck.

personality.text: Brave enough to stay open during the occupation, but too fearful to take an open stand for the Knights Radiant.
